column1: # Stage S11b, agent J3e1 — the world-export pipeline leaves developer_tools.
# developer_tools' world_export_pipeline module becomes the world_export_pipeline crate under
# tools/map_assets; its module root becomes the crate root, its command line `command_line.rs`, and
# its census kind test follows INSTANCE_KINDS into the prefab_catalog crate. The crate's error,
# prelude, empty-write refusal and export locations modules are written by hand, as are the
# INSTANCE_KINDS module of prefab_catalog and the cut of map_pipeline_layout.rs.
# Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the module root becomes the crate root; the command line and the module tests take their names
# the moved code names its own crate and its own export locations
# the raster pipeline, the map verification and the `world` binary name the crate
